item.title: Mexican-Americans Honor Independence Day September 16th
item.description: Mexico’s Independence Day, celebrated on September 16th, marks the anniversary of the Grito de Dolores, the call to arms initiated by Miguel Hidalgo in 1810 that ignited the Mexican War of Independence against Spanish rule.
